purpose: test-only model allowlist; never product hardcode

selection_policy.single_mode: prefer lower-cost eligible candidates in cost_priority; if model-specific behavior is suspected, advance to the next eligible candidate before attributing a product defect
selection_policy.adaptive_multi: restrict to allowed_models but let OpenCode-Hi choose by its normal capability/routing logic; do not force role-to-model mappings just to pass a test
selection_policy.free_model_behavior: quota/rate-limit/unavailable outcomes are intentionally observable test conditions

refresh_rule: Before a test run, intersect this intended pool with live `opencode models opencode-go` and `opencode models opencode`; do not assume a free model remains available because it was present earlier.
